r.s: Provides a class to decode mime messages.
r.d: Provides a class to deal with the decoding and interpreting of mime messages. This package used to be part of the Mail_Mime package, but has been split off.
r.n: Minor Bug fix release. #20431 - support for android #19762 - multipart signed not split correctly on line breaks #20027 - replace /e with preg_replace_callback #19762 - multipart/signed eating of new line, and expose sig_hdr etc.
